pattern: 甲斐がある（かいがある）
purpose: Say that an effort was worth making.
keywords: Vた / Nの + 甲斐がある
Getting up early was worth it. I saw a beautiful sunrise.
The practice paid off, and I played to the end.
This view makes the long journey worthwhile.
formation: Vた / Nの + 甲斐がある
restrictions: The outcome gives value to the effort; 甲斐がない denies that value.
mistake: Use 甲斐 for an effort and its payoff, not simple ability.
